2. Opened short position (entry.isSell() true). Expect profit negated.

3. Closed position (isOpened false) with long entry (sell false). Expect grossProfit = exitValue - entryValue.

4. Closed position with short entry (sell true). Expect profit = -(exitValue - entryValue) = entryValue - exitValue.
